name: gridpin
title: GridPin Offline Geocoder
description: Turn an address into a point and a point into an address on your Mac, without a network or an API key.
author: gridpin-reserve

commands.name: geocode-address
commands.title: Geocode Address
commands.subtitle: GridPin
commands.description: Find the latitude and longitude of an address in a country sheet on this Mac.

commands.name: reverse-geocode
commands.title: Reverse Geocode
commands.subtitle: GridPin
commands.description: Find the nearest addresses to a latitude and longitude in a country sheet on this Mac.

preferences.name: country
preferences.title: Default Country
preferences.description: The code of the sheet to ask first, e.g. fr or us. Empty: the first downloaded sheet.

preferences.name: gridpinPath
preferences.title: GridPin Program
preferences.description: Only if gridpin is not in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin or ~/.cargo/bin.

preferences.name: sheetsFolder
preferences.title: Sheets Folder
preferences.description: Only if your sheets are not in the folder `gridpin sheets where` prints (GRIDPIN_HOME).
